# [352] halos, all properties at [z=0] unless specified otherwise.

# columns: 
# [1] origID: Original Parent Halo ID (for reference only)
# [2] haloID: TNG-Cluster Halo ID (in the group catalog)
# [3] mhalo_200c: Halo mass within r200c [log M$_\odot$]
# [4] mhalo_500c: Halo mass within r500c [log M$_\odot$]
# [5] r200c: Halo radius r200c [Mpc]
# [6] r500c: Halo radius r500c [Mpc]
# [7] mstar_30kpc: Stellar mass within 30 kpc [log(M$_\star$ / M$_\odot$]
# [8] mstar_100kpc: Stellar mass within 100 kpc [log(M$_\star$ / M$_\odot$]
# [9] mhi_halo: Neutral HI mass within the (FoF) halo [log M$_\odot$]
# [10] mass_smbh: Mass of central SMBH [log M$_\odot$]
# [11] fgas_r500: Gas fraction within r500c [unitless]
# [12] sfr_30pkpc: Star formation rate within 30 pkpc (nan indicates an upper limit of -3.0) [log M$_\odot$ / yr]
# [13] xray_0.5-2.0kev: X-ray luminosity 0.5-2 keV soft-band, within r500c in 3D [log erg/s]
# [14] szy_r500c: Integrated Y_SZ parameter within r500c in 3D [log Mpc$^2$]
# [15] Bmag_uG_10kpc: Magnetic field magnitude within 10 kpc, mass-weighted mean of log(T)>5.5 gas [micro Gauss]
# [16] ne_10kpc: Electron density within 10 kpc, mass-weighted mean of log(T)>5.5 gas [log cm$^{-3}$]
# [17] temp_10kpc: Temperature within 10 kpc, mass-weighted mean of log(T)>5.5 gas [log K]
# [18] zform: Formation redshift [unitless]
# [19] richness_9.5: Number of satellite galaxies with log(M*) (30pkpc) > 9.5 Msun [unitless]
# [20] richness_10.0: Number of satellite galaxies with log(M*) (30pkpc) > 10.0 Msun [unitless]
# [21] richness_10.5: Number of satellite galaxies with log(M*) (30pkpc) > 10.5 Msun [unitless]
# [22] richness_11.0: Number of satellite galaxies with log(M*) (30pkpc) > 11.0 Msun [unitless]
# [23] coolcore_flag: Cool core status, based on central cooling time (0=CC, 1=WCC, or 2=NCC) {Source: Lehle+2024}
# [24] coolcore_tcool: Central cooling time, computed within a 3D aperture of 0.012*r500c {Source: Lehle+2024} [Gyr]
# [25] coolcore_entropy: Central entropy, computed within a 3D aperture of 0.012*r500c {Source: Lehle+2024} [keV cm$^2$]
# [26] coolcore_ne: Central electron density, computed within a 3D aperture of 0.012*r500c {Source: Lehle+2024} [log cm$^{-3}$]
# [27] coolcore_ne_slope: Central electron density slope (alpha), computed at 0.04*r500c {Source: Lehle+2024} [unitless]
# [28] coolcore_C_phys: X-ray concentration parameter C_phys, computed for 40kpc versus 400kpc. {Source: Lehle+2024} [unitless]
# [29] coolcore_C_scaled: X-ray concentration parameter C_scaled, computed for 0.15*r500c versus r500c. {Source: Lehle+2024} [unitless]
# [30] perseus_like_flag: Perseus-like flag (9=no, 1=yes) {Source: Truong+2024} [unitless]
# [31] peakoffset_xray_x: X-ray peak offset in x-direction [log pkpc]
# [32] peakoffset_xray_y: X-ray peak offset in y-direction [log pkpc]
# [33] peakoffset_xray_z: X-ray peak offset in z-direction [log pkpc]
# [34] peakoffset_sz_x: SZ peak offset in x-direction [log pkpc]
# [35] peakoffset_sz_y: SZ peak offset in y-direction [log pkpc]
# [36] peakoffset_sz_z: SZ peak offset in z-direction [log pkpc]
